parole.significato: cathedral (church serving as seat of a bishop, by extension, any large church)
parole.testo: 15th-century alteration (see below) of older Thum, from Middle High German and Old High German tuom, from Proto-West Germanic *dōm (whence Old Dutch duom, Middle Low German dôm), from Medieval Latin domus (literally “house”).
